text: in goods: Or, for good | body: Heb. belly
for to thee: Heb. which thou wouldst do
gather the grapes thereof: Heb. prophane, or use it as common meat
shall not be restored to thee: Heb. shall not return to thee, etc.
thou shalt not enjoy them: Heb. they shall not be thine
of fierce countenance: Heb. strong of face
bring upon: Heb. cause to ascend
